top_stories.title: Passkey-themed phishing attacks lead to Microsoft 365 data theft
top_stories.summary: Threat actors linked to ShinyHunters, Helix, and other extortion gangs are conducting phishing attacks themed around passkeys and single sign-on to compromise corporate Microsoft accounts. The attacks target Microsoft 365 services, exploiting user familiarity with passkey and SSO authentication flows as a social engineering vector.

top_stories.title: IDScan confirms breach after 153 million driver’s licenses leak on dark web
top_stories.summary: IDScan.net, an identity verification company, confirmed that hackers accessed customer data stored on its cloud platform after a dark web database containing over 153 million driver's license scans was linked to the firm. The Louisiana-based company, which processes ID verification for car rental companies, retailers, and cannabis dispensaries, posted a breach notice on September 4 acknowledging the incident.

top_stories.title: JumpCloud extends Agentic IAM with new controls for autonomous AI agents
top_stories.summary: JumpCloud has extended its Agentic IAM service with new controls that give IT teams direct management over autonomous AI agents within their organizations. The update positions AI agents within the same identity and access management framework used for human users and traditional workloads.

top_stories.title: MFA's Weakest Link: Account Recovery Is the New Attack Path
top_stories.summary: Attackers are increasingly bypassing MFA by targeting account recovery and password reset processes rather than the authentication methods themselves. Specops identifies service desk identity verification as a critical weak point vulnerable to social engineering attacks.

top_stories.title: Identity-Based AI Attack Threatens Security of Enterprise Data
top_stories.summary: A new attack technique called "workflow identity hijacking" has been identified that targets AI workflows to bypass standard security controls through unauthenticated entry points. The attack can compromise enterprise data by exploiting identity gaps in AI-driven workflows, posing risks to organizations relying on automated processes.

news.title: Okta Targets AI Agent Confusion With Identity Security Push
news.summary: Okta is positioning its identity security platform as a solution for managing AI agent access, focusing on where agents operate, which systems they can access, and what actions they are authorized to perform. The initiative targets the emerging challenge of governing non-human identities as AI agents proliferate across enterprise environments.

news.title: Florida confirms DMV database breached via stolen police account
news.summary: The Florida Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles confirmed a breach of its DAVID driver database after attackers used stolen credentials from a police department employee account. The incident involves unauthorized access gained through compromised law enforcement credentials, highlighting failures in privileged account security and access controls.

news.title: Artifactory flaws chained in attacks deploying backdoor malware
news.summary: Threat actors are chaining critical and high-severity JFrog Artifactory vulnerabilities to bypass authentication and gain administrative privileges on self-hosted servers. The attack chain results in deployment of a Rust-based backdoor on compromised systems.

news.title: AI is changing what Salesforce security needs to govern
news.summary: WithSecure published a paper titled "Navigating Trust in the Modern Salesforce Ecosystem" examining how AI is changing security and governance requirements for Salesforce environments. The paper argues that governance must expand beyond traditional identities, permissions, and access controls to include data trust, cross-system trust relationships, and AI-driven actions and outcomes.

news.title: Agentic Fabric and AI Could Drive SailPoint’s (SAIL) Next Growth Phase
news.summary: SailPoint reported its fiscal Q2 2027 results on September 9, showing 25% year-over-year growth in annual recurring revenue. The company is positioning its Agentic Fabric and AI capabilities as key drivers of its next growth phase in enterprise identity security.

news.title: Univention Corporate Server: Who Does the Cloud Trust When You Log In?
news.summary: Approximately 5,000 Dropbox accounts were accessed using Lenovo IDs that had not been properly verified, highlighting a federated identity trust issue in cloud environments. The incident illustrates how improper identity verification in cross-provider authentication relationships can lead to unauthorized account access.

news.title: authentik version/2026.8.2
news.summary: authentik released version 2026.8.2 of its open-source identity provider platform. The release supports SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, and RADIUS protocols for centralized authentication, authorization, and access management.

news.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act to Enforce New Reporting Requirements
news.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act begins enforcing a 24-hour mandatory reporting requirement for serious product security incidents. European organizations must notify EU authorities within 24 hours of discovering such incidents, introducing new compliance obligations relevant to IAM and security operations teams.

news.title: CISA Flags Exploited Cisco, Citrix, Fortinet Flaws, Sets Sept. 12 Federal Patch Deadline
news.summary: CISA added three actively exploited vulnerabilities affecting Cisco, Citrix, and Fortinet to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, requiring federal agencies to patch by September 12, 2026. One of the flaws, CVE-2026-20079, carries a CVSS score of 10.0 and involves an authentication vulnerability.

news.title: There's a New Black Market Just for Stolen ChatGPT and Claude Logins. It's Open 24/7.
news.summary: Okta has published a report revealing that stolen AI service account credentials (for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor) are being actively traded on Telegram-based black markets. These markets operate with 24/7 customer support, money-back guarantees, and bulk discount pricing structures for stolen tokens.

news.title: TATS
news.summary: A tool called TATS has been released for analyzing and tracking OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and Microsoft Entra ID tokens captured from Burp, mitmproxy, or Chrome DevTools. The tool visualizes token lifecycles, detects risky scopes, and enables token export for replay via an interactive dashboard.

news.title: Infostealer Logs Expose Replayable AI Tokens That Can Bypass MFA
news.summary: Cybercriminals are using infostealer malware logs to harvest replayable AI session tokens and API keys from platforms like Google and Anthropic, enabling account takeover that bypasses MFA controls. The attack leverages stolen session tokens rather than credentials, rendering traditional MFA protections ineffective against this lateral access method.

news.title: F5 BIG-IP APM Malware Injects a PHP Web Shell Into Memory, Evading Disk Scans
news.summary: Sophos researchers identified malware targeting F5 BIG-IP Access Policy Manager (APM) appliances that injects a PHP web shell into memory to evade disk-based detection. The malware hooks into Apache's PHP script loading process, keeping the disk copy clean while maintaining persistent access through three specific PHP scripts on the compromised appliances.

news.title: SailPoint, Inc. Q2 2027 Earnings Call Summary
news.summary: SailPoint held its Q2 2027 earnings call, with a summary produced by Moby. No specific financial figures, product announcements, or strategic details are provided in the description.

news.title: SailPoint Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
news.summary: SailPoint reported fiscal Q2 results with ARR rising 25% year over year to $1.231 billion and revenue increasing 17% to $309 million. SaaS ARR grew 36%, with overall performance exceeding expectations.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch update addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. AI is being credited for accelerating vulnerability discovery, though security experts note organizations are struggling to keep pace with testing and deploying the volume of monthly fixes.

news.title: Old, Unpatched Flaws Give Attackers Access to Philippines Nuclear Agency
news.summary: Threat actors exploited unpatched vulnerabilities in ownCloud to breach the Philippines Nuclear Agency, stealing reactor databases, personnel records, and credential stores. The attack leveraged commodity vulnerabilities to gain initial access, resulting in the compromise of sensitive credentials and identity-related data.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian drivers licenses, with the data apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has launched an official inquiry into the breach.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved credential-based intrusions into Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in the theft of over 100 million AT&T customer records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA issued a postmortem report on a data leak where a contractor publicly exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, on GitHub for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and response gaps relevant to secrets management and IAM practices.
